_provenance.method: tar/uImage/FIT unpack -> cpio(newc) -> usr/bin/hwscan -> printable-string extraction; preset arrays split at rodata stride gaps (>24B); model attribution by adjacent-name string + row-content matching vs 1.2.7 master; no disassembly, no code copying
caveats: ORACLE-CLASS ONLY per C2-F2: vendor capture, never a shipped DCENT_OS default
preset rows are power-target pairs (watt ~ TH/MH); frequency/voltage derived at runtime by VNish autotuner - NOT stored per preset
S21-family hydro model/mode attribution across sibling sets (S21 Hydro/S21e/S21+/S21 Pro) is ambiguous where sets share identical rows; label_confidence marks this

thermal/fan numeric constants (fan_min=10, PID target 65C, danger 90C etc.) are compiled Rust struct fields, not strings: 1.3.5 KEY SURFACE verified unchanged, VALUES not re-extracted desk-only; prior 1.2.7 mining values remain reference
watt/TH values are vendor planning tables, not measurements of any single unit

oracle_class_banner: ORACLE-CLASS FIXTURE (C2-F2): measured-anchor := DCENT_OS-measured only. This vendor table is an emulation-twin expected-value oracle and sanity bound; it MUST NOT become a shipped preset default.

key_surface_delta_1_2_7_to_1_3_5.interpretation: 1.3.5 adds a 'new_tuner' state machine (lower_percent/state_time/init_presets/reset_cores) and per-sensor timeouts; cooling-mode schema (auto PID target_temp / manual / immersion) and fan_min key surface carry over from 1.2.7. Numeric constant values are compiled, not string-visible (see caveats).

signature_scheme.label: [VNISH-proprietary], behavioral facts from runme.sh + package layout only
facts: per-artifact .sig files (512-byte = RSA-4096 class) alongside devicetree.dtb, vmlinux.bin, uramdisk.image.gz, fw.md5, runme.sh, sign-public.pem

verification: openssl dgst -sha256 -verify; fw.md5 carries MD5s of artifacts; target platform/install_type checked against /etc/fw-info.json
